description: Source code for agent command execution, including session management, transcript handling, and agent invocation logic in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: sessionFileHasContent
methods.description: Checks if a session transcript file exists and contains at least one assistant message, parsing JSONL line-by-line.

methods.name: persistSessionEntry
methods.description: Updates and persists a session entry in the session store and file.

methods.name: resolveFallbackRetryPrompt
methods.description: Generates a fallback retry prompt, preserving the original body if no session history exists.

methods.name: prependInternalEventContext
methods.description: Prepends internal event context to a body string if not already present.

methods.name: createAcpVisibleTextAccumulator
methods.description: Creates an accumulator object to process and merge visible text chunks, handling silent reply tokens.

methods.name: persistAcpTurnTranscript
methods.description: Persists a turn's transcript (prompt and reply) into session file and updates session manager.

methods.name: runAgentAttempt
methods.description: Main function to run an agent attempt, handling CLI sessions, embedded agents, and retries.

methods.name: buildAcpResult
methods.description: Builds a normalized result object from payload text and timing info.

methods.name: emitAcpLifecycleStart
methods.description: Emits an event indicating the start of an agent lifecycle phase.

methods.name: emitAcpLifecycleEnd
methods.description: Emits an event indicating the end of an agent lifecycle phase.

methods.name: emitAcpLifecycleError
methods.description: Emits an event indicating an error in the agent lifecycle.

methods.name: emitAcpAssistantDelta
methods.description: Emits an event with assistant delta text.
